tasks.title: Core queue logic in AgentRunnerService
tasks.description: Wire IssueTaskQueueRepo through StateManager into AgentRunnerService. Add task types (TaskType union, TaskRecord interface, EnqueueOptions, EnqueueResult, IssueQueueStatus, GlobalQueueStatus). Add in-memory data structures (runningSlots Map, pendingQueues Map). Implement enqueue() with priority insertion + DB persist, cancel(), cancelAll(), getQueueStatus(), and the event-driven schedule() method that picks the highest-priority pending task across all issues when a global slot is free. Old methods (startPipeline, resumePipeline, forceStop, isRunning) remain unchanged for now — queue logic is additive.
acceptanceCriteria: IssueTaskQueueRepo wired through StateManager getter, passed to AgentRunnerService constructor
enqueue(issueId, taskType, payload, options?) returns { taskId, status, queuePosition? }
enqueue with invalid issueId throws an error (enqueue rejected)
enqueue inserts a pending row in DB and adds to in-memory pending queue
Priority insertion: higher priority tasks sort before lower within the same issue's pending queue
FIFO within same priority: tasks with equal priority ordered by enqueued_at
schedule() starts the highest-priority pending task when a global slot is available
Per-issue serialization: schedule() skips pending tasks whose issue already has a running task
cancel(taskId) removes pending tasks (returns true), rejects running tasks (returns false)
cancelAll(issueId) cancels all pending + force-stops running task, releases slot
getQueueStatus(issueId?) returns running task, pending array, and queue length
All queue operations update DB state (status transitions, timestamps)
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This is the core task. The queue logic is additive — do NOT remove activeAgents/pendingGates yet. The old executePipeline() is called by the new executeTask() dispatcher (T-003). For now, enqueue just manages the queue data structures and schedule() calls a placeholder executeTask() that will be filled in T-003.

tasks.title: Task execution dispatcher + rebase executor
tasks.description: Implement the executeTask() dispatcher that routes tasks to the correct execution path. For start-pipeline and resume-pipeline, call the existing executePipeline() (adapted to accept task context). For rebase, create a new private method that performs the full rebase flow including conflict resolution as an internal sub-step — extract the 150-line conflict resolution chain from api/issues.ts lines 2275-2384 into AgentRunnerService. When a pipeline task reaches an approval gate, mark the task as completed and release the global slot. When a task is skipped (preconditions no longer met), mark as completed with result 'skipped' and release slot immediately.
acceptanceCriteria: executeTask() routes start-pipeline → executePipeline() from first stage
executeTask() routes resume-pipeline → executePipeline() from current stage
executeTask() routes rebase → rebase executor with embedded conflict resolution
Rebase executor performs: fetch, check fast-forward, rebase, conflict resolution (if needed), emit events
Approval gate detection: when pipeline reaches waiting-design-review or waiting-review, task is marked completed and slot released
Skipped tasks: when preconditions are not met, task marked completed with result 'skipped', slot released immediately
Task failures mark task as failed in DB with error message
All event emissions preserved (rebase_started, rebase_progress, rebase_completed, rebase_conflict, agent_conflict_resolution_started, etc.)
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The rebase executor needs access to WorktreeManager, ProjectRepo, and resolveConflictsViaAgent. These are already available or can be added to AgentRunnerService constructor. The conflict resolution chain currently lives inline in api/issues.ts — move it into a private method like executeRebaseTask().

tasks.title: Recovery on server restart
tasks.description: Implement recoverFromQueue() in AgentRunnerService, called during server startup. Load running tasks from DB: if the issue's approval_state.status is 'awaiting', mark task as completed (slot already free); otherwise mark task as failed with result 'Server restarted' and set issue status to interrupted. Load pending tasks from DB into in-memory pending queues. After recovery, call schedule() to start pending tasks that fit within the global slot limit. Update the existing recoverIssues() to call recoverFromQueue() as part of the startup sequence.
acceptanceCriteria: recoverFromQueue() loads all running tasks from DB
Running tasks with issue at approval gate (approval_state.status === 'awaiting') are marked completed, issue stage unchanged
Running tasks NOT at approval gate are marked failed with result 'Server restarted', issue set to interrupted
Pending tasks from DB are loaded into in-memory pendingQueues
schedule() is called after recovery to start eligible pending tasks
Existing recoverIssues() / recoverSingleIssue() still work for non-queue recovery paths
Integration with server startup sequence in server/index.ts
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The existing recoverIssues() in AgentRunnerService (lines 176-250) handles orphaned issues. The new recoverFromQueue() handles DB-persisted queue state. Both should run during startup. recoverFromQueue() runs first (restores queue state), then recoverIssues() handles any remaining orphans not covered by the queue.

tasks.title: API — convert mutation endpoints to enqueue + add queue endpoints
tasks.description: Replace the direct startPipeline/resumePipeline calls in the API handlers with enqueue() calls. /start → enqueue('start-pipeline'). /approve is a NEW handler (previously removed/404) that calls enqueue('resume-pipeline'). /reopen → pre-processing + enqueue('resume-pipeline'). /propose (in api/propose.ts) → enqueue('start-pipeline'). /retry → pre-processing (checkpoint check, status reset) + enqueue('resume-pipeline') or return without enqueue if reset to backlog. /rerun → pre-processing (checkpoint clear, status reset) + enqueue('resume-pipeline'). All enqueue calls return 202 Accepted with { taskId, status, queuePosition? }. Remove per-endpoint isRunning() + maxConcurrentAgents checks (~30 lines each). Replace /force-stop with cancelAll(). Add GET /issues/:number/queue and DELETE /issues/:number/queue/:taskId.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /start → enqueue('start-pipeline'), returns 202 { taskId, status, queuePosition? }
POST /approve → NEW handler created, enqueue('resume-pipeline'), returns 202
POST /reopen → pre-processing then enqueue('resume-pipeline'), returns 202
POST /propose → enqueue('start-pipeline') in api/propose.ts, returns 202
POST /retry → pre-processing (checkpoint check, status reset) then enqueue('resume-pipeline') when checkpoint found, or return 200 without enqueue when resetting to backlog
POST /rerun → pre-processing (fail coder sessions, clear checkpoint, reset status) then enqueue('resume-pipeline'), returns 202
POST /force-stop → cancelAll(), returns 200
GET /issues/:number/queue → 200 { running, pending, queueLength }
DELETE /issues/:number/queue/:taskId → 200 for pending, 409 for running, 404 for missing
isRunning() and maxConcurrentAgents checks removed from all converted handlers (issues.ts and propose.ts)
